title: Contribution Onboarding
description: Drain a crowdsourced contribution queue into a pull request, once a day.

agentSuggestions.label: Change when the run happens
agentSuggestions.prompt: Change the daily schedule of this Contribution Onboarding canvas. Ask me for the time and timezone, then update the cron expression on the Every day trigger.

agentSuggestions.label: Re-triage more rejected rows
agentSuggestions.prompt: This canvas re-triages at most 20 rejected contribution rows, and only when there is no pending or review work. Change that budget — ask me for the new limit and whether it should run even when fresh work exists.

agentSuggestions.label: Stop writing new adapters
agentSuggestions.prompt: Remove the new-adapter phase from this Contribution Onboarding canvas so runs only onboard boards for already supported sources. Keep the review rows listed in the pull request body for a human.

agentSuggestions.label: Report somewhere else
agentSuggestions.prompt: Replace the Telegram notification nodes on this canvas with a different channel. Ask me which one, then wire the integration and move the message text over.
